reviews.review_description:
First of all, excellent app with great graphics and a solid workout that is always fresh!

I would LOVE to see a visual indicator on the power behind my punches. I know to punch the glowing orbs harder, but I have no way to assess the power of my strikes overall.

Either a vertical strength meter on the side, or even better, having the orbs blow up in sparks or something extra grand when struck hard. Just something to let me know I'm not softening my punches late into the workout. Thanks!

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for the kind words! Bigger effects when you hit hard were already on our list, and your review moves them up. Thanks for being one of our first players, and if you have more ideas, we'd love to hear them at support@heatxr.com.

reviews.review_description: Great game! The pace is spot on and I really like how fast the targets come. Could you please add a Mixed Reality mode and lower body shots in a future update? That would make this even better.

developer_response.body:
You're the first person to review HeatXR, so this one means a lot to us. Thank you, and we're glad the pace suits you.

Mixed Reality is happening. We're starting on it this week, so you can box in your own room. Low punches are on our list too: targets at hip height that you punch from a squat.

We'll post here when the update is live. Thanks for jumping in this early.
